title: partnerships
text:
partnerships

alex.k: Heads-up — EU crossdock holding ~80 racks due to customs paperwork mismatch. This hits our Q2 dedicated commit for two SI customers. ETA unknown. Need options: swap to alternate DC, partner burst credit, or partial ship — can we confirm?

sana.r: ugh. which vendor and batch? any serial ranges?

alex.k: Vendor: NovaRack (batch 7). PO: 12345-EX. Serial ranges roughly A1000–A1080. Manifest shows 'DOC_MISMATCH' flag.

partner-ops-bot: Manifest update: NovaRack batch 7 flagged "HOLD_CUSTOMS_DOCS" status. Carrier: EuroLine. No ETA provided.

leon.t: This will reduce EU-dedicated throughput by ~18% if held >72h. If we can't reroute, canaries for Acme and ByteCloud will need to pause. Prioritize those SI commitments.

mike_p: Proposal: 1) Request temporary burst credit from cloud marketplace partner to cover capacity gap. 2) If denied, airlift 50 racks from APAC buffer. Airlift rough cost +$45k and 48–72h transit. Which do you prefer?

julia: Important: joint announcement cadence — if we shift capacity between regions or adjust SLAs, need to align comms and legal. Hold public-facing messaging until we decide.

sana.r: SLA note: we'll breach throughput SLO for the two SI customers if >15% drop persists for >72h. Need immediate account exec notif.

alex.k: Action items (short):
- Mike open vendor ticket + ask for expedited customs docs request
- Partner ops request burst credit from marketplace
- Logistics to get airlift quote (APAC -> EU)
- Eng to prepare canary pause plan if reroute impossible
I'll own coordination. :pray:

partner-ops-bot: Ticket NR-7890 created and assigned to vendor-contact@novarack.com. Request: provide customs invoice + packing list.

mike_p: Updated ticket NR-7890: vendor asks for copy of customs invoice + packing list. Upload requested docs here: https://s3.redwood/novarack/batch7/docs (read-only).

julia: Looping in account leads after we have a fallback. @leon.t please prepare a short customer note with fallback options and potential timelines.

leon.t: Drafting now — will ping when sent to Acme and ByteCloud.

sana.r: Legal check: we can offer a one-time credit up to $30k without exec sign-off. Anything above requires VP approval. Keep that in mind when negotiating burst credit.

alex.k: If vendor can't clear within 48h, escalate to airlift + exec approval for >$30k. Thanks everyone — will update thread as vendor responds.
